name: Cherumi
source:
Cherumi is Hagi's and Varlim's sister, and fourth elite member of the Misfits.
She, as well as her sister, was adopted at an unspecified age, and they supported Hagi's endeavor to suppress discrimination against Outliers on their home planet from the very beginning.
Cherumi is a kind, calm girl and appears like the polar opposite of her wild sister Varlim, but they get along splendidly despite their differences. She has a teasing streak and the habit of poking fun at her sister's apparent brother complex.
